gloss: right and wrong; good and evil

definitions.gloss: right and wrong; good and evil; justice and injustice
definitions.explanation: A formal compound contrasting the morally correct ({正|せい}) with the morally wrong ({邪|じゃ}). Used in writing and serious discussion to refer to the distinction itself.

examples.japanese: {正邪|せいじゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見極|みきわ}める→見極める：07171_mikiwameru⟧。
{正邪|せいじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Judging right and wrong is difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧{正邪|せいじゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Courts determine right and wrong based on the law.

notes:
A formal, written-Japanese compound. In everyday speech, ⟦{善悪|ぜんあく}→善悪：05563_zenaku⟧ (good and evil) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正邪|せいじゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge right and wrong
- {正邪|せいじゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見極|みきわ}める→見極める：07171_mikiwameru⟧: to discern right from wrong
- {正邪|せいじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧: the distinction between right and wrong

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{善悪|ぜんあく}→善悪：05563_zenaku⟧: good and evil — more common, used in both speech and writing
- ⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧: rights and wrongs; whether to do something — also means 'by all means' as an adverb
